thread:
eli_sales: Quick ask  BlueCrest Health wants a short dedicated POC and is requesting a steep trial discount (asking 42%). Need deal-desk guidance.

zoe_ae: Background: they're a vertical health-tech provider, potential ARR ~220k if they roll out to two lines of business. POC = 10 weeks, EU data residency required, SOC2 in progress.

omar_finance: 42% on dedicated infra will push contribution negative for the trial. What's the expected token/compute burn? Any post-trial commit signals?

eli_sales: Token estimate ~120M tokens/month during active testing. They indicated a likely 12-month commitment if latency & residency checks out; not signed yet.

mika_dealdesk: Standard eval concession band is up to 30% for trials. We can stretch to 35% with finance + legal conditions. For >35% need VP level sign-off and explicit strategic justification (reference, displacement).

sasha_infra: Ops note: reserved nodes for 10 weeks will require blocking capacity; recommend surge protection and an overage clause. Also performance may degrade if we use non-dedicated fallback.

omar_finance: I'll approve 35% conditional on: a) 12-mo commit >= $200k ARR post-trial b) first invoice of commit paid up-front c) overage billing at list if usage >150% forecast. Anything past 35% needs exec escalation.

eli_sales: Proposed counter to BlueCrest:
```
- 10-week dedicated POC (2 nodes)
- 35% discount during trial (conditional)
- Post-trial: 12-month minimum at $200k ARR, first month paid up-front
- Conditions: SOW + PO signed prior to kickoff, EU data residency clause, SOC attestation to be provided
- Ops: surge clause; overage billed at list >150% usage
- Legal: standard MSA; liability cap 1x fees for trial
```

zoe_ae: Customer verbally OK with 35% subject to SOC timeline and tighter residency language. They pushed hard because a competitor suggested a deeper trial discount.

mika_dealdesk: I'll provisionally approve 35% pending finance confirmation and SOW upload. If AE can secure reference/co-marketing we can consider a one-off exec discussion for more.

omar_finance: Confirmed  finance approves conditional 35%. Add an "accelerator" clause: if they convert to production above forecasted consumption, we apply a retroactive true-up to target margin.

legal_bot: Legal: will require precise data flow/residency text in SOW. SOC report timing must be explicit. Liability remains capped at 1x fees unless escalated.

eli_sales: Thanks team  I'll send the 35% counter and attach the draft SOW. Will upload PO once they sign.

mika_dealdesk: Provisional stamp: 35% Eval Concession. Attach docs here for audit when available. :white_check_mark:

eli_sales: Uploaded signed PO and countersigned SOW (link). Moving to contracting. Closing thread. :rocket:
